descriptions.text: Enchanted BigBoi Boxers. Have you ever read an Incredible Hulk comic and thought to yourself, everything rips off of his body except his pants? No way. Well, spoiler alert. You're not wrong. Size-altering and were-creatures, such as the BigBoi are required to wear enchanted, self-sizing items lest they wish to turn the dungeon into a nudist colony when they transform. That means everything they wear requires an enchantment. Everything, including their naughty little undies. + 2 to Constitution Wearer may cast a level 15 Protective Shell once every 30 hours.

Enchanted BigBoi Boxers. This item has been Upgraded once. All right, you already know the description of this item. Something something Incredible Hulk, blah, blah, blah. Now you want to know how this item has been upgraded. Right? So here are the original benefits of these naughty little undies: + 2 to Constitution Wearer may cast a level 15 Protective Shell once every 30 hours. That's some good shit right there. But we can do better than that. Here's a few additional benefits. + 5 to Dexterity + 5 to Intelligence + 3 more (for a total of + 5) to Constitution + The Freeballing Benefit

recap.text: Carl opens the boss box, tells himself to keep quiet, and says "Really? Fucking really?" to the ceiling anyway. Mordecai laughs behind him, then admits the prize is a good one: white boxers covered in little red hearts, the Enchanted BigBoi Boxers, with two Constitution and a level-fifteen Protective Shell once every thirty hours. Carl tells him not to look, pulls off his scorched, threadbare boxers, and puts the new pair on. The old ones fall apart in his hands.

Carl asks whether he can strip down to one item to steer a Scroll of Upgrade, and Mordecai says yes but advises against it. Carl activates it anyway, and his Enchanted BigBoi Boxers glow. They gain five Dexterity, five Intelligence, three Constitution, and the Freeballing benefit, which allows a single layer over the crotch. Mordecai and Donut laugh so hard Mongo wakes up.

One training room folds a regular training room, the magic workshop and the explosives studio, along with others, into a single space. Carl's ordinary spells sit in its list beside the spells that come from equipment, like Protective Shell. Training one of the equipment spells upgrades the equipment itself, so training Protective Shell upgrades his Enchanted BigBoi Boxers.

Carl's squad gets the same bundle of small flags as every other squad, with no say in the design. The Royal Court's flag is a little bigger than his hand: a miniature pair of heart-covered boxers flying sideways as if from a clothesline, with the Royal Court of Princess Donut embroidered top and bottom and Carl's bomb patch over the crotch. Carl finds it tacky, and Donut wants to know why they couldn't get a butterfly like Imani's.

Carl pulls a stinking kangaroo costume on, head over his own, and a loud click sounds. His boxers and kneepads now sit outside it, and two warnings say it has negated his boxer effects and his pedicure effects. As a long-haired dachshund, he finds the boxers resized and awkward on his hips, what dangles from one leg beyond his control. His kneepads stay, tiny on his back legs; his rings do not.

beats.headline: Really? Fucking really?
beats.text: Carl opens the boss box, tells himself not to say anything out loud, and says it to the ceiling anyway. Behind him Mordecai laughs, then adds that it is actually a really good prize: a white pair of boxers covered in little red hearts, the Enchanted BigBoi Boxers, plus two Constitution and a level-fifteen Protective Shell once every thirty hours. Don't look, Carl says. He pulls his scorched and threadbare boxers off and slips the new ones on, and the old ones fall apart in his hands.
beats.gist: Carl opens the boss box and puts on white boxers covered in red hearts.

beats.headline: Upgraded, with a catch
beats.text: A Platinum Quest Box holds five thousand gold and a Scroll of Upgrade with a twenty-minute timer: one random equipped item gets better. Carl asks whether he can strip down to a single item to steer it. Yes, says Mordecai, but he wouldn't: the upgrade is never very good when people do that. Carl activates it, and his Enchanted BigBoi Boxers glow. Five Dexterity, five Intelligence, three more Constitution, and the Freeballing benefit, which allows a single layer over the crotch. You motherfucker, Carl tells the ceiling. Well played. You shouldn't have said you really wanted those pants, says Mordecai, and he and Donut laugh so hard Mongo wakes up.
beats.gist: Carl activates the scroll and his boxers gain stats and the Freeballing benefit, to Mordecai's amusement.

beats.headline: Train the spell, upgrade the shorts
beats.text: One training room here combines a regular training room, the magic workshop, the explosives studio and several others into one. Carl's ordinary spells are listed as trainable alongside the spells that come from equipment, like Protective Shell. Apparently, train one of those here and it is the equipment itself that gets upgraded: in the case of Protective Shell, his boxer shorts.
beats.gist: Carl's boxers can be upgraded by training the Protective Shell spell in the combined training room.

beats.headline: The squad's flag
beats.text: Every squad on this level gets a bundle of small flags to stick into the monsters, and nobody gets to design their own. The Royal Court's flag is a little bigger than Carl's hand, and it is an actual miniature pair of heart-covered boxers flying sideways, as if from a clothesline, with the Royal Court of Princess Donut embroidered top and bottom like a motorcycle-club patch and Carl's bomb patch over the crotch. Carl finds it tacky. Elle says her squad's flag has a bag of adult diapers on it, Donut reports, and Imani's has a butterfly, and she wants to know why they couldn't get something like that.
beats.gist: Donut's squad flag is a miniature pair of heart-covered boxers with Carl's bomb patch, which Carl finds tacky.

beats.headline: Worn over a kangaroo
beats.text: Carl shoves his arms into a stinking costume and pulls the kangaroo head over his own. There is a loud click. His boxers and kneepads are now on the outside of the costume, his jacket still on the inside, his cloak round his neck. Then two warnings: his boxer effects have been negated by the costume, and so have his pedicure effects.
beats.gist: Carl pulls on the kangaroo costume, and its click negates his boxer and pedicure effects.

beats.headline: Resized for a dachshund
beats.text: Carl has turned into a long-haired dachshund, with a high voice, a German accent, no thumbs and legs far too short to drive. As with the kangaroo costume, he is still wearing his boxers. They have resized themselves and sit awkwardly on his hips, and what dangles out of one leg of them is beyond his control. His kneepads remain, tiny on his back legs; none of his rings do.
beats.gist: Carl, now a dachshund, still wears his self-resized boxers and kneepads, but no rings.

relations.note: the Royal Court's flag is a miniature pair of them
